color.$comment: DGA ships 41 colour families. The three named brand ramps below are DGA-specific; the semantic ramps and the wider primitive set are Untitled UI primitives that DGA adopted wholesale.

primary-sa-flag.$note: Green, chosen to reference the flag of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. No 600 step is defined under this name — brand-600 (#1b8354) fills that role.

gray.$note: Distinct from neutral. Carries a 1000 step.
